This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Senior Web Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join Street Diligence Inc. as a Senior Web Application Engineer, where you will play a key role in architecting and developing high-performance web applications. Your expertise in modern web development—including JavaScript frameworks, reusable UI components, and responsive design—will drive our innovative solutions. While experience with frameworks like Frappe and Django is an asset, we are primarily focused on robust full-stack development that leverages current technologies to build scalable and intuitive applications. A genuine passion for great user experiences is a must.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and Development:

  • Lead the design and development of complex, scalable web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue) along with backend technologies.
  • Build responsive, accessible, and engaging user interfaces that prioritize excellent user experiences.
  • Maintain a clean, efficient, and sustainable codebase following best practices.

Technical Leadership:

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance on modern web development practices, focusing on component-driven architectures and best coding practices.
  • Help conduct thorough code reviews to ensure high-quality software delivery.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies and assess their potential to enhance our web development processes.
  • Help establish robust component libraries and expand object composition

Project Management:

  • Collaborate with project managers and cross-functional teams to define project scopes, requirements, and timelines.
  • Lead technical planning and architecture discussions, ensuring that projects meet both business and technical goals.
  • Ensure on-time delivery of projects with a consistent focus on quality.

Testing and Optimization:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies to ensure the performance and reliability of our applications.
  • Demonstrate a passion for unit test coverage and behavior tests to maintain a high-quality codebase.
  • Optimize web applications for speed, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Quickly diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate design concepts into functional, visually appealing interfaces.
  • Partner with backend engineers to define and implement robust API integrations.
  • Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TABLE

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: A minimum of 5 years’ experience in web application development, with strong expertise in both frontend and backend technologies.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue).
  • Experience with backend technologies such as Django, Node.js, or similar frameworks.
  • Familiarity with building reusable UI components and integrating third-party APIs.
  • Additional Skills:
  • Strong understanding of SQL database technologies.
  • A passion for great user experiences, unit test coverage, and behavior tests.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a drive to build innovative solutions.
  • Outstanding communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Analista de Benefícios e Remuneração Jr
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.


Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo.


Descrição Breve do Cargo:

  • Promover a gestão dos benefícios de seguro de vida, planos de saúde, empréstimo consignado e veículos, controlar os pagamentos dos benefícios, Seguros de vida e planos de saúde, odontológico, empréstimos consignados e veículos,
  • Orientar colaboradores na concessão de empréstimo consignado,
  • Realizar o processo de inclusão e exclusão dos benefícios de plano de saúde, odontológico e empréstimo consignado no sistema da empresa,
  • Prestar informações e orientações a todos os colaboradores sobre os benefícios de saúde, empréstimo consignado e seguro de vida, montar processos em casos de sinistros,
  • controlar processos de assistência médica, executar outras atividades correlatas conforme orientação superior.
  • Executar demais atividades, conforme solicitação do gestor imediato


Instrução:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Contabilidade, Recursos Humanos ou áreas afins


Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse:

title: Agile Facilitator
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience as a Scrum Master , acting as the main Agile facilitator for development teams.
  • Solid Business Analysis fundamentals , including requirements gathering, refinement, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Outstanding communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience facilitating local and remote Agile teams .
  • Proven coaching and mentoring capabilities.
  • Strong background promoting Agile mindset, values, and culture .
  • Knowledge of additional Agile frameworks or methods (e.g., Kanban, XP, Lean).
  • Deep experience with refinement, story splitting, estimation, velocity tracking, retrospectives, and other Agile techniques.
  • Good understanding of software development practices such as TDD, BDD, unit testing, test automation, version control, and CI/CD.
  • Advanced English is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary Scrum Master, ensuring Agile values, principles, and practices are consistently applied.
  • Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies and support effective team decision-making.
  • Coach and mentor Scrum teams to continuously improve delivery, collaboration, and predictability.
  • Partner with the Product Owner to support backlog refinement, prioritization, and clarity of requirements.
  • Apply Business Analysis skills to help translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories when needed.
  • Identify and remove impediments, dependencies, and delivery blockers.
  • Promote cross-team collaboration and eliminate siloed ways of working.
  • Enable data-driven continuous improvement through metrics, insights, and retrospectives.
  • Ensure goals, scope, and priorities are clearly understood across the team.
  • Support effective demos, reviews, and product/system testing activities.
  • Facilitate alignment between technical teams and business stakeholders when challenges arise.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

Who We Are


COMO Digital Life is a regulated payment institution in Luxembourg, building next-generation financial infrastructure for global businesses. We blend cloud-native technology, rigorous compliance, and elegant engineering to deliver secure, reliable payment solutions.

We're looking for a Senior ABAP Cloud Developer who understands that the future of SAP is not in modifying standard code, but in building robust, cloud-native extensions using the RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), CDS Views, and SAP BTP. If you're ready to leave SE80 behind and embrace Eclipse/ADT, clean core architecture, and API-first development, you'll fit right in.


Your Mission


Your mission is to architect and deliver modern SAP solutions that power our financial operations, payment flows, and compliance reporting. You will champion the Clean Core approach, building upgrade-safe extensions that leverage SAP's latest cloud technologies.

Your work will directly shape the reliability, scalability, and intelligence of COMO's financial ecosystem—using ABAP RAP for transactional processing, CDS Views for high-performance data modeling, and SAP HANA for database-level optimization. You'll also leverage AI-assisted development practices to accelerate delivery and maintain code quality.


What You'll Do


  • Design and develop end-to-end applications using the ABAP RAP model (Managed and Unmanaged scenarios), including behavior definitions, validations, determinations, and actions.
  • Build and optimize CDS View Entities across interface, projection, and consumption layers with proper annotations and authorization via DCL.
  • Architect solutions that strictly adhere to Clean Core principles, utilizing released APIs, side-by-side extensibility on SAP BTP, and Key User Extensibility to keep systems upgrade-safe.
  • Develop high-performance data processing using SQLScript and AMDP, pushing logic to the SAP HANA database layer where appropriate.
  • Expose and consume OData services (V2 and V4), integrating SAP with external fintech platforms using SAP Integration Suite.
  • Conduct code reviews, enforce static code analysis (ATC), and write ABAP Unit tests to ensure financial-grade reliability and security.
  • Apply AI tools in development workflows to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, and optimization.
  • Mentor mid-level developers in the transition from classical ABAP to modern ABAP OO and Cloud methodologies.


What You Bring


  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of SAP ABAP development experience with deep expertise in ABAP Objects (OO design, interfaces, exceptions, clean code practices).
  • Proven hands-on experience with ABAP RAP (Behavior Definitions, Service Bindings, EML, transactional processing).
  • Expert-level knowledge of CDS Views including associations, annotations, and layered view design.
  • Experience with SAP BTP for building extensions and services that support clean core architecture.
  • Strong SAP HANA knowledge: SQLScript, AMDP, performance optimization, and database-level troubleshooting.
  • Experience with OData V2 and V4 service development and consumption.
  • Proficiency with Eclipse ADT (ABAP Development Tools) and Git-based version control (abapGit).
  • Professional proficiency in English for technical documentation and international collaboration.


Nice to Have


  • SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration experience.
  • SAP Fiori development experience (Fiori Elements, UI5, UI annotations strategy).
  • Knowledge of SAP CAP (Cloud Application Programming) model for polyglot development.
  • Experience with BTP services: Integration Suite, Event Mesh, Workflow Management, or Build Process Automation.
  • Fintech, banking, or high-volume transaction environment background.
  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools and practices.


Why Join Us?


  • Work on modern SAP engineering (RAP, CDS, BTP) instead of legacy-heavy maintenance—this is your career pivot into the future of SAP.
  • Build solutions for a regulated fintech where engineering quality, security, and reliability are first-class priorities.
  • True remote work from anywhere in Brazil with international exposure and meaningful ownership of cloud-ready SAP architectures.
  • Influence key automation, reporting, and integration initiatives in a tech-first culture.
  • Continuous learning support for certifications and training to keep you at the bleeding edge of the SAP roadmap.


How to Apply


Send your CV in English to with the subject \"Senior ABAP Cloud Developer\". Short-listed candidates will be contacted within two weeks.


Recruitment Process


1.      Screening Teams interview with HR (15 min).

2.      Technical conversation with our CTO (30-45 mins) to discuss your experience with RAP, CDS, and modern ABAP practices.


Ready to Join Us?


If you're excited about building cloud-native SAP solutions using RAP and CDS, enjoy solving complex architectural challenges with clean core principles, and want to contribute to a modern fintech leveraging AI and automation at its core - this role is for you.


We look forward to meeting engineers who value clean architecture, upgrade-safe extensibility, and high-quality code.

title: SDR - Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
Remuneração Fixo + variável - PJ - Vaga Home Office


Estamos em busca de um SDR (Sales Development Representative) para integrar nossa equipe de forma remota, atuando no atendimento inicial de leads via WhatsApp e chamadas de vídeo. Se você tem habilidade em comunicação, é organizado e busca uma oportunidade com potencial de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a meritocracia, essa vaga é para você.


⚠️ É imprescindível ter experiência prévia como SDR.


Habilidades e Qualidades Necessárias:

  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e empatia para entender as necessidades dos leads.
  • Disciplina e organização para gerenciar múltiplos atendimentos de forma eficiente.
  • Ambição e foco em resultados para alcançar e superar objetivos.
  • Capacidade de aprendizado rápido para assimilar os processos e ferramentas da empresa.
  • Resiliência e proatividade frente aos desafios.
  • Ser uma pessoa extremamente focada em resultados.
  • Experiência anterior como SDR é obrigatória.

Responsabilidades:

  • Receber e atender leads que chegam via WhatsApp de forma eficiente e acolhedora.
  • Coletar dados do lead, compreendendo suas necessidades e expectativas.
  • Realizar uma análise inicial para qualificar os leads de acordo com critérios estabelecidos.
  • Encaminhar os dados coletados e análises para o responsável, garantindo uma transição suave e eficaz.
  • Participar da conversa de Handoff com o closer.

Oferecemos :

  • Uma oportunidade de carreira em uma empresa em crescimento.
  • Um ambiente de trabalho meritocrático, onde seu resultado é reconhecido.
  • Treinamento e desenvolvimento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades.
  • Remuneração fixa + variável e bônus.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

• Participar juntamente com o time dos planejamentos;

• Participar de reuniões e discussões para definição de requisitos e estratégias de desenvolvimento;

• Apoiar outros membros da equipe ;

• Manter-se atualizado sobre as novas tecnologias e tendências do mercado;

Ser proativo na resolução de problemas e adaptar-se às mudanças do ambiente de trabalho.


Requisitos e qualificações


• Experiência com Moodle;

• Experiência com PHP;

• Experiência com desenvolvimento web (JavaScript, HTML, CSS);

• Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs Rest;

• Conhecimento em bancos relacionais, como MySQL, Oracle, Postgresql ou equivalente;

• Familiaridade com DevOps;

• Familiaridade com versionamento de código (Git);

• Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis;

• Habilidades de resolução de problemas;

• Proatividade e Adaptabilidade;

Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Diferenciais:

• Experiência em testes unitários;

• Familiaridade com serviços em nuvem (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud);

Cursos de especialização e certificações.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

title: Analista de Helpdesk Trainee
description:
Descrição da Posição


Buscamos um(a) Helpdesk Support Analyst – Trainee para atuar no suporte técnico de primeiro nível, auxiliando usuários na resolução de problemas, abertura e acompanhamento de chamados, além de apoiar na organização e cumprimento dos níveis de serviço (SLA). O(a) profissional terá a oportunidade de aprender e se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar abertura, registro, acompanhamento e encerramento de chamados técnicos;
  • Atuar na tratativa de backlogs e no suporte à resolução de incidentes;
  • Apoiar o controle e acompanhamento de SLAs;
  • Prestar suporte básico a usuários em ambiente Windows;
  • Utilizar sistemas de gestão de tickets para organização e priorização das demandas;
  • Comunicar-se de forma clara e objetiva com usuários e equipe interna;
  • Contribuir com ideias, melhorias de processos e adaptação a mudanças.


Requisitos

  • Experiência inicial ou vivência na área de TI (suporte/helpdesk);
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de tickets;
  • Noções de acompanhamento de chamados, incidentes e SLA;
  • Conhecimento básico em ambiente Windows (Windows 10);
  • Conhecimento básico no pacote Office (Outlook, Excel, Word);
  • Conhecimento básico em processos ITIL;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Pontualidade, postura profissional e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Perfil proativo, colaborativo e com facilidade de adaptação.


Diferenciais

  • Cursos ou certificações introdutórias em ITIL ou Suporte Técnico;
  • Experiência acadêmica ou estágio na área de TI.


Venha se conectar conosco!

A empresa tem uma equipe global com pessoas de diferentes origens e culturas, o que torna o ambiente de trabalho mais rico e interessante. Com 15 centros de entrega global nos EUA, México, China, Brasil, Argentina, Costa Rica, Espanha, Hungria e Índia, a Softtek ajuda a melhorar e produzir resultados previsíveis para corporações de primeira linha em mais de 20 países. title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (ETL) SR


Estamos buscando um Engenheiro de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Migração de Dados OnPrem para Google Cloud Platform (GCP) no setor financeiro. Esse profissional será responsável pela construção, otimização e orquestração de pipelines de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, eficiência e governança durante o processo de migração.


Descrição do Cargo:

O Engenheiro de Dados GCP Sênior será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, etc.). Além disso, atuará com ferramentas de ETL, preferencialmente Informatica PowerCenter ou soluções similares, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, assegurando que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados, assegurando boas práticas de versionamento, performance e reutilização.
  • Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.
  • Implementar e manter processos de ETL, preferencialmente utilizando Informatica PowerCenter ou ETL similar, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e governança dos dados migrados.
  • Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.
  • Analisar e reestruturar processos de ETL, facilitando a migração para a nova arquitetura de dados em GCP.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções escaláveis e sustentáveis.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Conhecimento avançado em BigQuery e estruturação de dados no Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Proficiência em SQL para manipulação e otimização de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de scripts de transformação e automação.
  • Experiência com ETL, preferencialmente Informatica PowerCenter ou ferramentas similares (Talend, DataStage, etc.).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração de dados e integração entre diferentes plataformas.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com DBT para modelagem de dados, versionamento e boas práticas de engenharia analítica.
  • Vivência no setor financeiro e familiaridade com práticas de governança de dados.


Benefícios e Diferenciais:

♂ Parceria com TotalPass para acesso a academias e atividades físicas.

Oportunidades de treinamento e cursos em tecnologias de dados.

Auxílio com certificações oficiais, com 100% de reembolso ou vouchers.

Parcerias com instituições de ensino para graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.

Contratação PJ.

Trabalho 100% remoto, atuando em cliente do segmento financeiro.

title: OPERADOR DE CALDEIRA
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nossos objetivos.


Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo.


Descrição Breve do Cargo :

Operar caldeiras, efetuar a dosagem de produtos químicos nas caldeiras, monitorar o descarregamento de BPF de carretas para tanques, realizar manobras de descarregamento de óleo diesel, operar estação de tratamento de agua, realizar a movimentação de insumos para a Refinaria, operar plantas de branqueamento e desodorização, executar suas atividades conforme rotinas operacionais, atuar, sempre que necessário, nas áreas de carregamento e formulação e na Estação de Tratamento de Efluentes, executar outras atividades correlatas conforme orientação superior.



Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Segurança na Operação de Vasos de Pressão - NR 13.
  • Flexibilidade de aprendizagem.
  • Experiência como operador de Caldeira ou de Produção.
  • Interesse em aprender sobre processos industriais.
  • Informática básica/intermediária.


Nossa Empresa

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse:


#VemSerAgropalma

title: Senior Network Implementation Engineer – Juniper/MIST
description:
Senior Network Implementation Engineer – Juniper/MIST

Remote working - report to US


NTT DATA Inc. is a multinational technology company offering services in software development, security, cloud, and especially IT infrastructure. According to Great Place to Work, we are among the best technology companies to work for in Brazil. We foster an inclusive work culture and highly value the freedom to improve processes, flexibility, and respect for people!

To achieve great things together, NTT DATA Inc. believes in and fully supports diversity. Our company is open to everyone, regardless of disability, gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, age, origin, or appearance.


What Will You Do?

As a Level 4 Juniper Route/Switch, WAN Edge, Wireless, and MIST Solutioning Engineer, you will:

  • Design, implement, and manage advanced network solutions focused on Juniper technologies (route/switch, WAN edge, wireless, MIST, SDWAN, SSR).
  • Lead design and delivery projects, working closely with clients to meet complex requirements.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, ensuring high-quality work and continuous improvement.
  • Provide architectural guidance and consulting on best practices for network design and implementation.
  • Conduct hands-on installation, configuration, and maintenance of Juniper network components.
  • Write reports, proposals, and maintain project documentation.
  • Engage with vendors for priority escalations and troubleshooting.
  • Take ownership of relevant technologies and lead by example in project execution.


What Do We Expect From You?

  • Advanced/Fluent English – daily contact with the US is required.
  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Information Technology, Computing, or related field.
  • Professional certification in Juniper technologies (JNCIE, JNCIP, etc.).
  • Knowledge of Cisco technologies and certifications (CCNP, CCIE, etc.).
  • Minimum 10 years of network engineering experience, with at least 7–10 years leading design and delivery for professional services.
  • Strong consulting, communication, and client engagement skills.
  • Ability to coach and mentor team members.
  • Extended experience in Juniper SDWAN and SSR technologies.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and report writing abilities.


What Do We Offer?

  • CLT employment contract
  • Work equipment provided
  • Meal/food vouchers
  • Home office allowance
  • Health and dental plans for you and your family
  • Group life insurance
  • Totalpass (gym partnership)
  • Maternity kit and extended paternity leave
  • Birthday day off
  • Opportunities to participate in social initiatives
  • Incentives for education and training
  • An inclusive work culture where together we achieve great things!


Location

Remote Working

title: Engenheiro de IA (LLM)
description:
#VemPraTrinks


A Trinks é uma plataforma SaaS líder em gestão e agendamento para salões de beleza, barbearias, clínicas estéticas e estabelecimentos de bem-estar em todo o Brasil. Estamos construindo uma nova frente de produto baseada em inteligência artificial generativa , com foco em automação de atendimento e gestão do ERP.


Buscamos um profissional com perfil técnico sênior, com vivência em IA generativa e engenharia de software, para liderar o desenvolvimento de um novo produto baseado em modelos de linguagem (LLMs) , integrando inteligência artificial ao core de serviços da Trinks.


Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução:


  • Liderar e desenvolver a criação de um sistema conversacional com IA generativa (LLM);
  • Projetar arquitetura escalável e segura com integração aos sistemas da Trinks;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times de Produto, UX, Dados e Engenharia;
  • Implementar soluções baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) com foco em contexto e precisão;
  • Definir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento, testes e deploy de soluções com IA;
  • Acompanhar performance, custo e segurança dos modelos em produção.


O que você precisa para o #match perfeito:


  • Experiência consolidada em engenharia de software;
  • Experiência prática com LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, etc.);
  • Domínio de Python (e desejável experiência com C#/.NET);
  • Conhecimento em LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Familiaridade com sistemas assíncronos/event-driven (Kafka, SQS, etc.).


Será um diferencial se você conhecer:


  • Ter liderado ou desenvolvido projetos com IA generativa e agentes conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering, embeddings, vetores e fine-tuning leve.
  • Experiência com mecanismos de controle de alucinação e segurança em LLMs.


Saca só o que OFERECEMOS:


100% Home office;

⏳ Contratação CLT (40 horas semanais);

Auxílio home office;

Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível;

Plano de Saúde SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

Plano Odonto SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

title: Partnership Analyst
description:
Job Description


At Pluria Global , we continue to grow at an extraordinary pace. That’s why we’re looking for a true rockstar to join our mission of redefining how people and companies work together. We provide companies and employees with a disruptive solution that enables them to work from any workspace affiliated with our network (coworking spaces, business centers, private and flexible offices, hotels, libraries, cafés), where users can find and book their workspace in just one click . Unlock potential through real connections.


Pluria is a multinational startup founded in Romania, with presence in Spain, Argentina, Peru, Mexico, Chile, Brazil, Portugal, and Colombia. Our goal is to become the global solution that supports companies on their journey to becoming flexible organizations . We operate in a market growing 215% in LatAm and 55% in Colombia .


At Pluria, we believe the true engine of progress lies in real connections : when teams feel connected, both people and companies thrive. That’s why our purpose is to create connected teams that boost engagement, innovation, and results—because better companies lead to better economies and, ultimately, a better quality of life.


‍ We achieve this by bringing together three forces:

  • A network of locations that brings offices, hubs, and flexible spaces into one accessible network.
  • Bottom-up coordination , enabling intentional encounters through bookings, invitations, and approvals.
  • Top-down intelligence , delivering actionable data so leaders can make better decisions.


This is how we unlock true performance by transforming work into a space for connection, collaboration, and shared growth .


Some numbers that back us up:

  • Global presence in over 10 countries
  • More than 1,000 workspaces worldwide
  • 20% month-over-month growth
  • A global team of 30+ people
  • 100% remote and multicultural team

title: Desenvolvedor (a) de Automações Pleno
description:

O que esperamos de você?


Domínio em lógica de programação e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Experiência com automações de processos (integrações entre sistemas).

Conhecimento em SQL Server, incluindo consultas, modelagem de dados e otimização de desempenho.

Experiência em ferramentas de automação de processos, como UiPath, Open RPA, N8N ou similares.

Experiência com plataformas como Power BI ou Tableau para criação de dashboards e relatórios interativos.

Conhecimento em plataformas de desenvolvimento como Python e ferramentas semelhantes.

Atuação em squads de projetos com participação na criação e desenvolvimento de produto/automação.


Quais serão os seus desafios?


Análise de requisitos e desenvolvimento de soluções técnicas eficientes, atuando diretamente na manutenção de sistemas e aplicações da empresa.

Atuar na análise de necessidades propondo soluções de automações sistêmicas e RPA garantindo o melhor uso dos softwares da empresa.

Desenvolver scripts ou manipulação de dados para melhoria sistêmica e/ou segurança dos dados.

Gerenciar e configurar sites e pools de aplicativos, autenticação (SSL, HTTPS), reescritas de URL e otimização de desempenho e segurança.

Sustentação e manutenção de softwares de ERP e HCM, incluindo customizações e suporte a usuários finais.

Atuar em práticas de DevOps, incluindo pipelines CI/CD e ferramentas como Jenkins, GitLab CI ou Azure DevOps.

Atuar em squads de novas soluções propondo soluções que atenda a necessidade das áreas de negócio.

Operar em linguagens similares, como JavaScript, PowerShell ou Shell Script.


Diferenciais: Experiência em projetos de automação/RPA.

Experiências em projetos com IA.


Desejáveis: Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação de processos, como Python, UiPath, Open RPA, N8N ou similares.

MUITAS, queremos todos felizes e realizados!

Vale refeição sem desconto;

Descontos em estabelecimentos parceiros;

Plano de saúde Unimed Nacional com 100% do subsídio do escritório da mensalidade no titular;

Plano odontológico;

Bolsa de estudos;

PPR;

Seguro de vida;

Prêmio por tempo de casa;

Folga de aniversário;

Gympass;

Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico com recursos modernos.


Todas as nossas oportunidades estão disponíveis para ambos os sexos e pessoas com deficiência.

title: JIRA Support
description:
We are a US startup company headquartered in New York City (


We deliver innovative applications and data solutions to consumers and enterprises. Our projects typically include healthcare, social, financial, gaming, and shopping elements.


We provide an exciting environment with others who share a passion for excellence. Come meet us and see for yourself if you want to join a growing international business.


Position: JIRA Support


Support the next generation of healthcare and factory automation applications and services powered by AI and excellent experiences. Join a team of experienced startup developers building out highly scalable service architectures to radically change the status quo in healthcare and factory automation.


Desirable experience:

  • Interest in support and QA roles
  • Deep understanding of JIRA
  • Understanding of JIRA API’s and ability to use them
  • Understanding of JIRA performance and tuning
  • Can-do attitude, ready to pitch-in to improve overall processes


Desirable subject matter expertise: 

  • Jira, ITSM, and process workflow.


Minimum Applicant Requirements:

  • Excellent command of English, written and spoken
  • Ability to work independently and as a team member
  • Self-starting, well-organized, and enthusiastic work style
  • At least 2+ years of working experience in relevant technologies


Additional requirements:

This position requires a background check of your work and life experience by a 3rd party.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible work/life balance
  • Work with the latest technologies
  • Work with a small, intense, and fun team


Applicant Questions

SUBMISSIONS WITHOUT ANSWERS TO THESE QUESTIONS WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED:

If you are interested in the position, please compose a written introduction to yourself in the English language, including answers to the questions below, as well as anything else we should know, and send it along with your resume.


  • When can you start?
  • How many years have you worked full-time as a JIRA Admin?
  • What hourly rate do you charge for full-time contract jobs?
  • Please include a short video describing your favorite past project. Be sure to tell us why you liked it.


Due to the number of applications from fake identities, you will be required to present an ID (Passport or Driver’s License) sufficient to verify your identity at the beginning of your first interview.

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.


Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.


We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.


What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.


As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.


The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.


This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.


Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.


The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.


You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.



What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency


Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow \"show-don't-tell\" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale


Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency


You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention


You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)



What We Offer

Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency



How to Apply

Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:


When submitting you'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences): Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.


We're excited to meet you!

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.


Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.


We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.


What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.


As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.


The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.


This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.


Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.


The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.


You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll

  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency


Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow \"show-don't-tell\" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale


Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency


You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.

title: Especialista ABAP
description:
Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Estamos com uma oportunidade para o nosso time corporativo para: Especialista ABAP


Experiência Profissional


Necessário Inglês avançado ou fluente


  • Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência
  • Excelente conhecimento em desenvolvimento ABAP no S/4, incluindo Steampunk e conceitos de SAP Clean Core
  • Conhecimento em criação de CDS Views , ODATA & REST e integração orientada por APIs .
  • Experiência em ABAP on S/4 HANA de 3 a 4 anos – CDS , AMDP (ABAP Managed Database Procedures) e table functions , RAP Framework (RESTful Application Programming)

  • Experiência com Adobe Forms
  • Conhecimento do processo SolMan Charm
  • Conhecimento em pesquisa de SAP Notes como parte do tratamento de defeitos. Registrar OSS-cases na SAP e instalar SAP Notes
  • Conhecimento em instalação e/ou ativação de versões de países do S/4
  • Conhecimento em instalação de namespaces para integração com sistemas legais
  • Inglês para escrita e conversação
  • Conhecimento em tributação do Brasil
  • Conhecimento em tributação do Peru e do Chile será um diferencial
  • Espanhol será um diferencial


Formação Acadêmica


  • Graduação completa.


Idioma


  • Inglês - Avançado ou Fluente

  • Remoto

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Company Description

Sofia Health is a technology platform that powers booking, payments, scheduling, and operational infrastructure for independent health and wellness professionals. Our work is systems-driven, detail-heavy, and requires precision across data, reporting, and written materials.


We’re hiring a highly detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support internal operations, reporting, and editorial quality control—not just admin tasks.


This Role Is a Strong Fit If You:
  • Are meticulous with data, documents, and formatting
  • Instinctively catch errors, inconsistencies, and missing details
  • Can read critically and edit for clarity without changing intent
  • Are comfortable switching between spreadsheets, reports, and written content
  • Take pride in clean, accurate, professional output


This is not a social media, inbox-only, or calendar-focused VA role.


Core Responsibilities


Data & Reporting
  • Organize, clean, and maintain structured data in spreadsheets and internal systems
  • Build, update, and format reports (tables, summaries, exports)
  • Work extensively with Microsoft Office , including:
  • Excel (formulas, filters, sorting, validation)
  • Access (tables, queries, data management, exports)
  • Word & PowerPoint (consistent formatting and layout)
  • Use Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for collaboration
  • Verify data accuracy before internal or external use
Reading, Editing & Quality Control
  • Review documents, reports, emails, and internal materials
  • Correct grammar, spelling, formatting, and clarity issues
  • Ensure consistency in terminology, structure, and presentation
  • Identify errors, omissions, and inconsistencies before delivery
  • Follow style and formatting guidelines precisely
Operational Support
  • Maintain organized file structures and naming conventions
  • Follow SOPs closely and flag issues proactively
  • Support detail-heavy operational tasks across teams


Required Skills & Experience
  • Experience in a data-heavy administrative, operations, or QA role
  • Strong Excel skills (required)
  • Experience with Microsoft Access or similar database tools
  • Excellent written English and strong editing instincts
  • High attention to detail and formatting standards
  • Comfortable managing multiple tasks without sacrificing accuracy


Nice-to-Have
  • Experience supporting SaaS or platform-based companies
  • Background in reporting, auditing, or editorial review
  • Familiarity with structured operational data


What Success Looks Like
  • Data is clean, accurate, and reliable
  • Documents are polished, consistent, and error-free
  • Issues are caught early and communicated clearly
  • Systems stay organized without constant oversight

title: Recruiter
description:
Job Title: Technical Recruiter

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Full-time


Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Technical Recruiter based in Brazil to support end-to-end recruitment for technology roles across engineering, data, cloud, and emerging tech domains. This is a fully remote position, collaborating with global hiring managers to attract, evaluate, and hire top technical talent.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle: sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer negotiation, and onboarding support
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand technical requirements and hiring priorities
  • Source candidates using multiple channels including LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, and technical communities
  • Screen resumes and conduct initial technical and behavioral interviews
  • Coordinate and schedule interviews with candidates and interview panels
  • Maintain accurate candidate records in ATS and ensure recruitment metrics are tracked
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of technical talent for current and future needs
  • Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process
  • Support employer branding initiatives and recruitment marketing activities


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in technical recruitment or IT staffing
  • Strong understanding of technical roles such as Software Engineers, DevOps, Cloud, Data, AI/ML, and QA
  • Experience sourcing candidates for remote and global roles
  • Familiarity with ATS tools and LinkedIn Recruiter
  • Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal)
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience recruiting in Latin America or global markets
  • Knowledge of modern tech stacks (Java, Python, React, Cloud platforms, DevOps tools, etc.)
  • Prior experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills
  • Strong screening and assessment abilities
  • Time management and multitasking skills
  • Data-driven mindset with attention to detail

title: Senior Frontend Developer \"976706\"
description:
Quem Somos


A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


Desenvolver interfaces de usuário visualmente atraentes e funcionalmente eficientes.

Criar aplicações web bem arquitetadas, responsivas e de alto desempenho.

Construir código e bibliotecas reutilizáveis para uso futuro.

Garantir a viabilidade técnica dos designs de UI/UX.

Otimizar aplicações para máxima velocidade e escalabilidade.

Colaborar com o time de design utilizando ferramentas como Figma, Sketch e outras.

Participar de sessões de brainstorming e outras atividades de geração de ideias com a equipe.

Implementar padrões de desenvolvimento e seguir as melhores práticas.


O que você precisa ter

  • React;
  • Redux;
  • JavaScript;
  • HTML;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação.


Onde você vai trabalhar


No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


Desenvolver interfaces de usuário visualmente atraentes e funcionalmente eficientes.

Criar aplicações web bem arquitetadas, responsivas e de alto desempenho.

Construir código e bibliotecas reutilizáveis para uso futuro.

Garantir a viabilidade técnica dos designs de UI/UX.

Otimizar aplicações para máxima velocidade e escalabilidade.

Colaborar com o time de design utilizando ferramentas como Figma, Sketch e outras.

Participar de sessões de brainstorming e outras atividades de geração de ideias com a equipe.

Implementar padrões de desenvolvimento e seguir as melhores práticas.


O que você precisa ter

  • React;
  • Redux;
  • JavaScript;
  • HTML;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação.


Onde você vai trabalhar


No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Senior AI Automation Engineer
description:
Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience building integrations, automations, or workflow systems
  • Strong proficiency with low-code/no-code automation platforms (n8n,AI for business automation- Tray.ai, Zapier,Make | AI Workflow Automation Software & Tools ,or similar)
  • Solid JavaScript skills -most automation logic happens in JavaScript nodes and custom functions
  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar) and prompt engineering
  • Experience working with REST APIs, webhooks, and authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, JWT)
  • Understanding of data transformation and formats (JSON, XML, CSV)
  • Ability to read API documentation, debug integration issues, and troubleshoot automation failures
  • Experience building event-driven workflows and handling asynchronous processes
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Self-motivated, disciplined, and comfortable working independently across time zones
  • Great communication skills - ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Your English is at least at the Upper-Intermediate level to communicate with our teams
  • Preferred Skills/Abilities
  • Experience building AI agents or multi-step LLM workflows (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom implementations)
  • Python scripting for data processing, API integration, or ETL workflows
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools or iPaaS platforms (Temporal, Workato, MuleSoft)
  • Understanding of vector databases and semantic search for RAG implementations
  • Experience with freight, logistics, or supply chain systems and terminology
  • Knowledge of SQL and database queries for data analysis
  • Background in operations, RevOps, data engineering, or technical product roles
  • Experience measuring and optimizing automation ROI (cost per call, error rates, processing time)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and serverless architectures
  • Understanding of microservices architecture and event-driven systems


Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy AI-powered automation workflows using low-code platforms and custom JavaScript
  • Build intelligent systems that leverage large language models (LLMs) for decision-making, data extraction, and process automation
  • Create and maintain integrations between internal systems and third-party platforms using APIs, webhooks, and event-driven architectures
  • Develop data pipelines that transform, enrich, and route information across multiple systems and data sources
  • Implement prompt engineering strategies and design multi-step LLM orchestration workflows
  • Build and optimize automated workflows that eliminate repetitive manual tasks across operations teams
  • Monitor automation health, debug failures, and continuously optimize workflows for reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency
  • Identify new automation opportunities by collaborating directly with operations, product, and engineering teams
  • Document workflows, create runbooks, and establish best practices for scalable AI automation
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to shared automation libraries, frameworks, and templates
  • Measure and report on automation performance metrics, including accuracy, latency, cost savings, and operational impact
  • Prototype new AI capabilities and experiment with emerging technologies as part of our Technical Innovation Program
  • Example Projects & Initiatives To give you a sense of the types of challenges you'll tackle, here are examples of projects our AI Automation Engineers work on:
  • Intelligent Document Processing:
  • Build systems that automatically extract structured data from unstructured documents (PDFs, emails, images)
  • Create validation workflows that use AI to verify data accuracy and flag anomalies for human review
  • Design document classification systems that route different document types to appropriate processing pipelines
  • Implement OCR + LLM workflows that handle handwritten or poorly scanned documents
  • AI-Powered Business Process Automation:
  • Develop AI agents that conduct multi-step research and qualification processes autonomously
  • Build conversational systems that handle routine inquiries and escalate complex cases appropriately
  • Create intelligent routing and matching systems that optimize business outcomes using historical data and ML models
  • Design automated scheduling and coordination systems that handle complex business logic and constraints
  • System Integration & Data Orchestration:
  • Connect internal platforms with external third-party services, handling authentication, rate limiting, and error recovery
  • Build real-time data synchronization pipelines that keep multiple systems consistent
  • Create webhook listeners and event processors that trigger automated workflows based on external events
  • Design data enrichment pipelines that pull information from multiple sources and merge it intelligently
  • Operational Intelligence & Monitoring:
  • Build automated alerting and notification systems that detect anomalies and trigger appropriate responses
  • Create dashboards and reporting workflows that aggregate data from multiple sources
  • Develop predictive systems that use historical patterns to forecast operational needs
  • Design automated quality control systems that continuously validate data accuracy across systems
  • AI Innovation & Experimentation:
  • Prototype new AI capabilities using the latest LLM models and techniques
  • Experiment with vector databases, semantic search, and retrieval-augmented generation(RAG)
  • Build proof-of-concepts that demonstrate the business value of emerging AI technologies
  • Contribute to our Technical Innovation Program (TIP) with novel automation approaches
  • Platform & Infrastructure:
  • Develop reusable automation components, templates, and design patterns
  • Create internal tooling that makes it easier for other teams to build and deploy automations
  • Establish monitoring, logging, and observability standards for automation workflows
  • Build testing frameworks that ensure automation reliability and catch regressions
  • These projects span multiple teams and business functions - you'll have the opportunity to work on whatever creates the most business value, from carrier operations to customer experience to internal productivity tools.

title: Talentos
description:
Banco de Talentos – Estágio & Início de Carreira

Áreas: Vendas | Finanças | Produto | Marketing


Sobre a Trendz

Somos uma agência focada em conectar marcas, influenciadores e eventos para criar experiências de alto impacto no digital e no presencial. Atuamos desde a construção de campanhas estratégicas até o desenvolvimento de produtos, ativações e projetos proprietários dentro do ecossistema da Creator Economy.

Trabalhamos lado a lado com grandes marcas, criadores de conteúdo e parceiros estratégicos, sempre com foco em resultado, criatividade e execução de alto nível.

Se você é curioso, gosta de aprender rápido e quer entender como negócios reais crescem na prática, esse banco de talentos é para você.


Sobre o Banco de Talentos

Este banco de talentos é voltado para estudantes e profissionais em início de carreira que desejam se desenvolver em uma das áreas abaixo:

  • Vendas e Desenvolvimento de Negócios
  • Finanças e Operações
  • Produto e Estratégia
  • Marketing e Conteúdo


As oportunidades podem surgir no formato de estágio, projetos temporários ou posições de entrada, de acordo com a demanda da agência e o fit do candidato.


Áreas de Atuação

Vendas e Desenvolvimento de Negócios

Apoio na prospecção de marcas e parceiros estratégicos.

Qualificação de leads e apoio nas etapas iniciais do funil de vendas.

Criação de apresentações comerciais, propostas e follow-ups.

Apoio na organização de CRM e pipeline comercial.

Finanças e Operações

Apoio no controle financeiro de projetos e campanhas.

Organização de contratos, invoices, pagamentos e repasses.

Apoio na construção de relatórios financeiros e indicadores.

Interface com times internos para garantir organização e previsibilidade.

Produto e Estratégia

Apoio no mapeamento de necessidades de clientes, influenciadores e projetos internos.

Organização de processos e fluxos operacionais da agência.

Análise de dados, feedbacks e resultados de campanhas.

Apoio no desenvolvimento e melhoria de produtos e serviços da Trendz.

Marketing e Conteúdo

Apoio na produção e organização de conteúdos para redes sociais.

Pesquisa de tendências, referências e formatos de conteúdo.

Apoio na gestão de redes sociais, campanhas e projetos de branding.

Organização de materiais institucionais, apresentações e cases.


Requisitos Gerais

Estar cursando graduação ou em início de carreira.

Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.

Perfil curioso, organizado e com vontade real de aprender.

Interesse por marketing, influência digital, negócios, startups ou economia criativa.

Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas e ambientes dinâmicos.


Diferenciais

Experiência prévia, mesmo que em projetos pessoais, voluntariado ou estágios.

Familiaridade com ferramentas como Notion, Google Slides, Google Sheets e CRMs.

Interesse em crescimento profissional nas áreas de growth, negócios, produto ou marketing.

Proatividade para propor melhorias e novas ideias.


O que oferecemos

Aprendizado direto com profissionais experientes e atuação prática.

Ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e com alto nível de autonomia.

Participação em projetos com grandes marcas, influenciadores e eventos relevantes.

Possibilidade real de crescimento e efetivação conforme performance.

title: Talentos
description:

Áreas: Vendas | Finanças | Produto | Marketing


Sobre a Trendz

Somos uma agência focada em conectar marcas, influenciadores e eventos para criar experiências de alto impacto no digital e no presencial. Atuamos desde a construção de campanhas estratégicas até o desenvolvimento de produtos, ativações e projetos proprietários dentro do ecossistema da Creator Economy.

Trabalhamos lado a lado com grandes marcas, criadores de conteúdo e parceiros estratégicos, sempre com foco em resultado, criatividade e execução de alto nível.

Se você é curioso, gosta de aprender rápido e quer entender como negócios reais crescem na prática, esse banco de talentos é para você.


Sobre o Banco de Talentos

Este banco de talentos é voltado para estudantes e profissionais em início de carreira que desejam se desenvolver em uma das áreas abaixo:

  • Vendas e Desenvolvimento de Negócios
  • Finanças e Operações
  • Produto e Estratégia
  • Marketing e Conteúdo


As oportunidades podem surgir no formato de estágio, projetos temporários ou posições de entrada, de acordo com a demanda da agência e o fit do candidato.

Vendas e Desenvolvimento de Negócios

Criação de apresentações comerciais, propostas e follow-ups.

Apoio na organização de CRM e pipeline comercial.

Finanças e Operações

Apoio no controle financeiro de projetos e campanhas.

Organização de contratos, invoices, pagamentos e repasses.

Apoio na construção de relatórios financeiros e indicadores.

Interface com times internos para garantir organização e previsibilidade.

Produto e Estratégia

Apoio no mapeamento de necessidades de clientes, influenciadores e projetos internos.

Organização de processos e fluxos operacionais da agência.

Análise de dados, feedbacks e resultados de campanhas.

Apoio no desenvolvimento e melhoria de produtos e serviços da Trendz.

Marketing e Conteúdo

Apoio na produção e organização de conteúdos para redes sociais.

Pesquisa de tendências, referências e formatos de conteúdo.

Apoio na gestão de redes sociais, campanhas e projetos de branding.

Organização de materiais institucionais, apresentações e cases.

Estar cursando graduação ou em início de carreira.

Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.

Perfil curioso, organizado e com vontade real de aprender.

Interesse por marketing, influência digital, negócios, startups ou economia criativa.

Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas e ambientes dinâmicos.


Diferenciais

Experiência prévia, mesmo que em projetos pessoais, voluntariado ou estágios.

Familiaridade com ferramentas como Notion, Google Slides, Google Sheets e CRMs.

Interesse em crescimento profissional nas áreas de growth, negócios, produto ou marketing.

Proatividade para propor melhorias e novas ideias.


O que oferecemos

Aprendizado direto com profissionais experientes e atuação prática.

Ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e com alto nível de autonomia.

Participação em projetos com grandes marcas, influenciadores e eventos relevantes.

Possibilidade real de crescimento e efetivação conforme performance.
